reason: I run three AI agents and context switching does hurt, but Cursor and Copilot already share context inside their own editor, and as a compliance buyer I need SSO, audit log, and FIPS before anything touches our code — the pitch promises none of that. I'm not handing session data to an unknown vendor at $30/seat on day one.
objection: No SSO, audit log, or FIPS mentioned anywhere; I can't buy a tool that doesn't clear our compliance baseline, and no one I trust is vouching for it yet.
would_change_my_mind: SOC 2, SSO, audit logging, and FIPS support, or an engineering lead I already trust vouching for it.
